repos_data.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
Give your AI agent eyes and hands on any desktop — cross-platform accessibility API with MCP server

Windows computer-use MCP server: drive any desktop app via semantic discover-then-act targeting (entities + leases, not pixel coordinates), with per-action perception guards, a native Rust UIA engine, Chrome CDP, and Key Locker credential autofill for ssh/sudo password prompts. Works with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
Apache-2.0, model-agnostic macOS agent: bring your own model to deliver verified code, docs, slides, and computer actions.
Computer Experience Layer — MCP server for native computer use on macOS. Structured perception, reliable actions, continuous awareness.
Build shared AI workspaces for creation, simulation, verification, MCP tools, and replayable receipts.
